    All Classes and Interfaces

    Classes
    Class
    Description
    EditorActivityListener
    Receives BlueJ editor document changes and records text-change events, including active and idle editing intervals.
    EditorTracker
    Tracks open BlueJ Java editors and attaches document listeners so text edits can be recorded as telemetry events.
    JSONExporter
    Serializes session metadata, analytics and individual telemetry events into a formatted JSON report.
    PDFReportGenerator
    Creates a PDF report summarizing session metrics, event timeline information and error frequencies.
    TelemetryAnalytics
    Calculates compilation, execution, error-frequency and editor-activity metrics from recorded telemetry events.
    TelemetryAnalyticsPlugin
    BlueJ extension entry point that registers IDE listeners, records package, compilation, invocation and class events, and exports reports when a session finishes.
    TelemetryCollection
    Stores the telemetry events captured during a recording session and provides safe access to a copy of the list.
    TelemetryEvent
    Represents one timestamped telemetry event and its optional compilation, execution, editor-activity or class metadata.
    TelemetrySession
    Records the start and end of a telemetry session and calculates its elapsed duration in seconds.
